Resource Profile: ISiKMedikament

Official URL: https://gematik.de/fhir/isik/StructureDefinition/ISiKMedikament Version: 0.0.1
Active as of 2025-12-17 Computable Name: ISiKMedikament

Dieses Profil ermöglicht die Abbildung von patientenunabhängigen Informationen zu Medikamenten in ISiK Szenarien.

Usages:

  • Examples for this Profile: Medication/ExampleISiKMedikament1, Medication/ExampleISiKMedikament2, Medication/ExampleISiKMedikament3, Medication/ExampleISiKMedikament4... Show 6 more, Medication/ExampleISiKMedikament5, Medication/ExampleISiKMedikament6, Medication/ExampleISiKMedikament7, Medication/ExampleISiKMedikament8, Medication/ExampleISiKMedikament9 and Medication/ParacetamolInfusion
  • CapabilityStatements using this Profile: ISiK CapabilityStatement AMTS Akteur (Expanded) and ISiK CapabilityStatement MedikamentRolle

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
